refusal.wrongCharacter: This roll belongs to another character.

refusal.boostCannotBePaid: A boost can only be invoked for free.
refusal.paidRepeat: You already paid to invoke this aspect on this roll.
refusal.busy: The last action is still in progress.
refusal.noRoll: There is no roll to invoke on.
refusal.settled: This roll’s result is settled and takes no more invokes.

blocked.privateAudience: The original roll was shown to only some people, so the invoke result will not be sent to chat.
blocked.notPosted: The original roll could not be confirmed as posted, so the invoke result will not be sent.
blocked.noBinding: The table the original roll went to could not be confirmed, so the invoke result will not be sent.
blocked.bindingChanged: The table connection or character has changed, so the invoke result will not be sent.

invoke.keepLocal: Keep it on this sheet only
invoke.noteChat: Confirming sends a new roll message to the same audience as the original; the original message is not changed.
invoke.noteLocal: This invoke stays on the sheet; nothing is sent to chat.
invoke.noteNothingYet: Nothing is spent until you confirm.
invoke.playOnly: Switch to play mode to invoke.

tray.title: Dice tray
tray.help: Tap a skill to roll: overcome against +0. Long-press, right-click or Shift+Enter for options.
tray.scalePending: The scale bonus is added once the roll succeeds.
tray.settled: This roll’s reward was taken; the result is settled.
tray.readOnly: A read-only sheet can roll but cannot invoke or take outcomes.
tray.deliveryChat: Invokes go out as new roll messages to the original roll’s audience.
tray.deliveryLocal: Invokes on this roll stay on the sheet.

deliveryBlocked.privateAudience: The original roll was private: choose to keep invokes on this sheet first.
deliveryBlocked.notPosted: The original roll could not be confirmed as sent: choose to keep invokes on this sheet first.
deliveryBlocked.noBinding: The original roll’s table could not be confirmed: choose to keep invokes on this sheet first.
deliveryBlocked.bindingChanged: The table connection has changed: choose to keep invokes on this sheet first.

tray.nonAtomic: If the message fails, points aren't refunded.
tray.playOnly: Switch to play mode to invoke, reverse or take outcomes.

delivery.pending: Invoke recorded on the sheet; sending the message…
delivery.posted: Invoke recorded on the sheet; message sent.
delivery.rejected: Invoke recorded on the sheet, but the chat refused the message.
delivery.unknown: Invoke recorded on the sheet; whether the message arrived is unknown, so check the chat. It will not be resent or refunded automatically.
delivery.reversed: This invoke was undone and refunded.

offers.fail: Fail: the goal is not met
offers.majorCost: Or succeed at a serious cost

offers.armorBoost: Armor stops the hit: the attacker gains a boost
offers.enemyFreeInvoke: The opponent gains a free invoke

offers.freeInvokes: {count} free {count, plural, one {invoke} other {invokes}} on the aspect

table.title: Invoke at the table
table.subtitle: The table settles it: the payment, the +2 or reroll and the chat message go out together.
table.payerWallet: Paid from this character's fate points ({count} left)
table.payerPool: Paid from the GM scene pool ({count} left)
table.noPayer: No fate point source can pay
table.hostile: Hostile invoke: they get a fate point when the scene ends
table.paidRepeat: This roll already paid for this aspect.
table.gmAudience: A GM-only roll: payments others would notice and public free invokes cannot be used.
table.note: On confirm the table settles it at once and posts a new roll message to the same audience; the original message is not changed.
table.delivery: This roll is at the table: invokes are settled there with their payment.
table.revisionPosted: The table settled this invoke and posted it.
table.noClaim: At the table, the GM hands out boosts and free invokes on the scene board.
table.scaleSkipped: The table totals the roll as rolled; an after-roll scale effect is not included.
table.confirmAgain: Confirm again (resends the same operation; never charges twice)

failure.forbidden: The table refused: you may not do that.
failure.not_found: The roll or the aspect is gone or out of sight.
failure.conflict: The table changed (the scene ended, the result moved on or the rules are off). Nothing was charged.
failure.invalid: The table did not accept it (already paid, not enough points or a GM-only roll). Nothing was charged.
failure.unavailable: Connection lost; the outcome is unconfirmed. Confirm again; it never charges twice.
failure.audience: The table takes rolls for everyone or for the GM only. Choose another audience.
failure.readOnly: The table keeps this copy but cannot be reached: view only, no rolls or invokes.
failure.busy: The last action is still running.
failure.noRoll: No roll to invoke on yet.
failure.editMode: Switch to play mode to invoke.
failure.abandoned: Stopped waiting: if the roll did reach the table, chat shows it, but this sheet does not keep it.

actions.unavailable: The table is out of reach: fate points and invokes are view only.
actions.handIn: Hand in to the GM pool

failed.forbidden: You may not hand in points.
failed.not_found: No table fate points for this character.
failed.conflict: The table changed; nothing was handed in.
failed.invalid: Not enough points or a wrong amount; nothing was handed in.

actions.sceneClosed: Scene {ordinal} “{title}” ended: press Scene end on the sheet to clear stress.

table.rootPending: Whether this roll reached the table is unknown. Confirm again resends the same operation; it never rolls twice.
